lines.beaver: 민수야, 요즘 얼굴이 안 좋아 보여. 괜찮아?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, you don't look well lately. Are you okay?
lines.beaver_roman: minsuya, yojeum eolguri an joa boyeo. gwaenchana?
lines.learner: 요즘 기력이 너무 없어. 맥이 다 빠졌어.
lines.en: I have no energy these days. I'm totally drained.
lines.roman: yojeum giryeogi neomu eopseo. maegi da ppajyeosseo.

lines.beaver: 어디가 제일 힘든데? 자세히 말해 봐.
lines.beaver_en: What's the hardest part? Tell me more.
lines.beaver_roman: eodiga jeil himdeunde? jasehi malhae bwa.
lines.en: Even climbing stairs makes me breathe heavily.

lines.beaver_en: Is your pulse normal? Did you check it?
lines.en: The hospital told me my pulse is fast.
Yeah, I quit. They said my lungs are fine.

lines.beaver: 다행이다. 다른 데 아픈 곳은 없어?
lines.beaver_en: That's a relief. Does anything else hurt?
lines.beaver_roman: dahaengida. dareun de apeun goseun eopseo?
lines.en: My shoulders are stiff and the back of my neck often hurts.

lines.beaver_en: Maybe it's from using the computer too long.
lines.en: Right. My right arm tingles and my thumb hurts too.

lines.beaver: 소화는 잘 돼? 밥은 잘 먹고?
lines.beaver_en: How's your digestion? Are you eating well?
lines.beaver_roman: sohwaneun jal dwae? babeun jal meokgo?
lines.learner: 입맛이 없어서 잘 못 먹어. 속도 더부룩해.
lines.en: I have no appetite, so I can't eat much. My stomach feels bloated too.
lines.roman: immasi eopseoseo jal mon meogeo. sokdo deoburukae.

lines.beaver_en: Are you going to the bathroom okay? That matters too.
lines.en: My bathroom trips are irregular too. I feel like my body is aging.

lines.beaver: 일 때문에 운동을 계속 미룬 거지?
lines.beaver_en: You kept putting off exercise because of work, right?
lines.beaver_roman: il ttaemune undongeul gyesok mirun geoji?
lines.en: Yeah, I put my health on the back burner too much.

lines.beaver: 무리하지 마. 내일부터 나랑 같이 걷자.
lines.beaver_en: Don't overdo it. Let's walk together from tomorrow.
lines.beaver_roman: murihaji ma. naeilbuteo narang gachi geotja.
lines.en: Thanks. I'll walk with you starting tomorrow.
